correctness.rationale: Directly enumerate the 15 maximal eight-vertex neighborhoods and all 2880 nonempty faces; all seven rational boundary ranks computed exactly by Fraction elimination, full boundary-square-zero identities checked. For each of 11 S_6 cycle types, exhaustive fixed oriented simplex signs give a complete H_3 trace. Jacobi-Trudi irreducible characters checked mutually orthonormal over all 11 classes, and their sum reconstructs every trace, with dimension 91. The 7-cut equivalence is checked by exhaustive seven-subset enumeration and proved by splitting six endpoints. Rational quotient homology follows from invariant homology for finite groups after barycentric subdivision. No unproved infinite extrapolation or integral claim.

value.rationale: The complete naturally acting S_6 homology module of T_6, a canonical 15-vertex triangular graph at the last single-degree neighborhood homology stage before T_7, is not determined by its previously computed mod-two rank. The module has eight distinct irreducible Specht constituents and a single alternating-invariant sign line, revealing a sharp distinction between full and even-label symmetry quotients. It is a complete equivariant invariant with a clear topological and representation-theoretic use, not an arbitrary slice.
